verdict: Leads arrived at a better cost, but pipeline visibility needs repair now.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 122 leads entirely through Meta at a cost per lead of $11.57. In the most recent 7 days, spend pulled back by roughly half — and while that reduced lead volume by 31%, cost per lead actually improved by 28%, meaning the remaining budget is working more efficiently. However, 83 opportunities are sitting in your CRM with zero appointments and zero wins recorded, which points to a gap in how leads are being followed up once they arrive — not an ads problem. Two tracking and contact-cleanup items are being completed this week to restore full visibility into your August results, and the scoreboard will be trusted and reviewed by month-end.

cost per lead this period, down 28% in the last 7 days

watch_item.issue: Leads are arriving but not showing as appointments or wins in your CRM, making it impossible to read the true August result.
watch_item.fix: Attribution and contact-sync work is being completed now so the full pipeline is visible and trusted before the month-end review.
